scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run governance:check && pnpm run slice1:evidence:check && pnpm run slice2:evidence:check && pnpm run snapshot:check && pnpm run boundary:check && pnpm run protected:check && pnpm run secrets:scan && pnpm run secrets:scan:independent && pnpm run secrets:scan:history && pnpm run dependency:check && pnpm run license:check && pnpm -r --if-present check
scripts.test: pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 --if-present test && pnpm run test:slice1:api && pnpm run test:slice2:api && node --test test/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:slice1:api: pnpm --filter @matchbase/application build && pnpm --filter @matchbase/security build && node --test test/slice1/api/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:slice2:api: pnpm --filter @matchbase/application build && pnpm --filter @matchbase/security build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/slice2/api/*.test.mjs test/slice2/repository/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:ci: pnpm run snapshot:prepare && pnpm run build && pnpm run check && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:standalone:repeat && pnpm run test:browser
scripts.test:browser: pnpm --filter @matchbase/security build && playwright test && node scripts/scan-slice1-runtime-artifacts.mjs
